rationale: Georgi is building AI agent systems to automate GTM workflows for startups, while Aditya is an embedded systems engineer deploying intelligent control models on resource-constrained hardware—both are working at the intersection of AI deployment and real-world constraints. Aditya's hands-on experience with edge AI, TensorFlow Lite, and microcontroller optimization could inform how Rilo's multi-agent systems scale efficiently, and Georgi's conviction that automation lets small teams punch above their weight aligns with Aditya's focus on bringing RL and computer vision to practical, resource-limited applications.
intro_message: Georgi, meet Aditya Bangde—a roboticist and embedded systems engineer working on edge AI and intelligent control; his experience deploying ML on microcontrollers could complement your thinking on how agentic automation scales in resource-constrained environments.
